en: POKéMON is life!\nAnd to live is to play games!
You can't be a coward in the world\nof POKéMON!
I did my best.\nI have no regrets.
Spread the word to save energy!
I just became a TRAINER.\nBut, I think I can win.
My POKéMON couldn't win…\nHaven't they grown enough?
You were just lucky, that's all.
I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning.
Darn!\nMy POKéMON need to be stronger!
There's a fat POKéMON that comes\ndown from the mountains.\pI bet it'd be strong if you can\ncatch it.
Well, better get back to work.
I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now!
Tch…\nI better go find stronger ones!
